games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: Why did the soldiers stop the old farmer’s funeral?
choices: The soldiers said no gatherings were allowed and that the funeral was a prohibited event, because every event now had to be approved first.
They clean the environment by eating dead animals, which helps stop disease from spreading and keeps the food web healthy.
Amal says injustice is like typhoid — you do not always see it, but it poisons everything — comparing the hidden illness in the water to the hidden harm of unfair rule.
rounds.answer: The soldiers said no gatherings were allowed and that the funeral was a prohibited event, because every event now had to be approved first.
rounds.explanation: In the story the soldiers declare the funeral a prohibited event and insist that all events, even grief, must follow their rules.

rounds.prompt: What reason did the soldiers give for burning the school books?
choices: Amal says injustice is like typhoid — you do not always see it, but it poisons everything — comparing the hidden illness in the water to the hidden harm of unfair rule.
The soldiers said no gatherings were allowed and that the funeral was a prohibited event, because every event now had to be approved first.
They claimed the books contained propaganda and said the villagers must only learn what the soldiers allowed.
rounds.answer: They claimed the books contained propaganda and said the villagers must only learn what the soldiers allowed.
rounds.explanation: In part two the soldiers call the books propaganda and burn several, telling the villagers to learn only what is permitted.

rounds.prompt: According to the passage, why are eagles and vultures important to the ecosystem?
choices: They claimed the books contained propaganda and said the villagers must only learn what the soldiers allowed.
They clean the environment by eating dead animals, which helps stop disease from spreading and keeps the food web healthy.
The soldiers said no gatherings were allowed and that the funeral was a prohibited event, because every event now had to be approved first.
rounds.answer: They clean the environment by eating dead animals, which helps stop disease from spreading and keeps the food web healthy.
rounds.explanation: The text states that these birds of prey play an important role because they clean the environment by eating dead animals.
